entries.en: The property report records an outstanding tax lien.
entries.zh: 房产报告记录了一项尚未解除的税收留置权。

entries.en: The rider pressed the motorcycle's kick starter.
entries.zh: 骑手踩下了摩托车的脚踏起动器。

entries.en: The witness gave a self-contradictory account of the journey.
entries.zh: 证人对行程作了自相矛盾的陈述。

entries.en: The diary gradually exposes the writer's self-deception.
entries.zh: 日记逐渐暴露了作者的自欺。

entries.en: Refusing all feedback became a self-defeating strategy.
entries.zh: 拒绝所有反馈成了一种适得其反的策略。

entries.en: The team packed photographic equipment in waterproof cases.
entries.zh: 团队把摄影器材装进了防水箱。

entries.en: The agreement grants an exclusive right to publish the manuscript.
entries.zh: 协议授予出版这份手稿的专有权。

entries.en: The anatomical model shows the ear canal clearly.
entries.zh: 解剖模型清楚地显示了耳道。

entries.en: The dancer used large balloons during the bubble dance.
entries.zh: 舞者在泡泡舞中使用了大气球。

entries.en: The case record identifies a streptococcal throat infection.
entries.zh: 病例记录指出了一次链球菌咽部感染。

entries.en: The airport terminal has separate halls for arrivals and departures.
entries.zh: 机场航站楼设有分开的到达大厅与出发大厅。

entries.en: The theory describes reproductive memory as replaying stored stimulus information.
entries.zh: 这套理论把还原性记忆描述为重现储存的刺激信息。
